Name: Exhaustion Expanded
Author: AzureblueZ29
Description:
[size=6][b]Exhaustion Expanded[/b][/size]

This mod is a fork of another mod called Exhaustion Tweaks that seems to have been abandoned in 2024 with Stardew Valley 1.4. The author was kind enough to post source code for it, so I updated it for Stardew Valley 1.6 and added integration for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Configuration Menu (GMCM)[/url].

This mod gives the player more flexibility on how passing out is handled. It stops Jojo Mart and others from trespassing onto your farm to tuck you in bed when you fall asleep on your own property. Also adds configurable stamina costs to staying up late. 
[size=5][b]
Prerequisites[/b][/size]

Mandatory and optional requirements for use of this mod.
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.0+[/url]﻿﻿ (required)[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Download and install the required prerequisites.[/*]
[*]Download the latest version of this mod.[/*]
[*]Unzip the downloaded file into the [u]Stardew Valley/Mods[/u] directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

This mod can be run without any configuration at all, if desired.

Below are the features of the mod and what it will default to without any configuration:

[list=1]
[*]It allows you to add a list of save locations where you can fall asleep without risk of Jojo Mart or others "finding" you and robbing you of 10% of your cash to move you to bed.
[list]
[*]By default, these safe locations are the Farm, the FarmCave and any FarmBuildings. At time of writing new locations can only be added in the config.json file and it's the only option not in GCGM. I'm working to see if it can be included there. I don't currently have a list of available locations, but I'm looking to either find one or make one. I added a brand new option to allow all locations to be considered safe, by request from the previous mod.[/*]
[*]By default, there is a low chance (10%) that you can be robbed for 5% to 25% of your cash.  This can be disabled and is configurable.[/*]
[*]By default, this option is enabled, but you can also add a restriction that these locations are safe only if you have a spouse.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]This mod will add a configurable stamina cost to passing out at 2am.  This is just to add some consequence for staying up so late in places where the monetary cost does not apply.  This feature can either be configured or disabled.[/*]
[*]Finally, this mod will add a stamina cost to staying up after a specified time.
[list]
[*]By default, if you stay up after midnight you will lose 5% of your total stamina every 10 minutes.[/*]
[*]This automatic stamina reduction will not drop you below 10 stamina points (this amount is configurable).[/*]
[*]The start time and the percentage lost every 10 minutes are configurable.[/*]
[*]This feature is enabled by default, but can be disabled.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]The mod's configurable options can be found below. These can either be adjusted through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Configuration Menu (GMCM)[/url] or the [u]config.json[/u] file. Editing the options using GMCM is easier. GMCM will also provide descriptive tooltips if the option itself is not clear.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

This mod is made for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] using [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b]. This mod will [b]not[/b] work on versions prior to those mentioned.

This mod [i]should[/i] work with most all mods except those that also adjust exhaustion (doesn't seem to be many of those). I plan on testing it with SVE specifically soon.

There is an Enabled true/false toggle you can use to turn the mod on and off at any time if you notice a conflict.

[size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size]

The only text this mod affects is in the GMCM mod options. At the time it is only English, but I'm willing to add additional languages if the mod becomes widely used. It would be pretty easy as it is only a few lines of text.

[size=5][b]Contact[/b][/size]

Please leave a comment on the NexusMods page detailing your issue. If you prefer, you could send a DM on Nexus.
